scope: Native formatter calendar validation and typed CLI/HTTP checkpoint; full parity remains incomplete.

reference_provenance.method: opaque defining-module bytes, CRLF normalized to LF, no source decoding

validation.independent_review: No actionable findings in the calendar formatter checkpoint.

comparison_limits: Public missing values are normalized; Python missing-sentinel identity is not claimed.
Native error checks verify rejection and input state, not Python exception class/message identity.
Column labels and selector names are native strings; non-string labels remain excluded.
Finite parser, categorical and numeric observations do not establish all pandas extension dtypes, formatting, overflow, timezone or mixed-scalar coercion behavior.
CSV/pandas reader inference and mixed XES/CSV formatter adapters remain follow-on work.

resolved_gap.behavior: Mixed floating/integer timestamp categories reject when exact unique values collapse during inferred floating-category conversion. Equal values retain their first representative.

calendar_validation.behavior: Explicit date formats reject impossible Gregorian calendar dates for conversion, preserving the complete column as text. Valid leap days and month-end dates convert normally.
calendar_validation.before_fix: The transport comparison failed at calendar_invalid_february.
